description: This Java class defines integration tests for loan next payment due amount calculations in the Apache Fineract project. It uses the JUnit framework and Lombok for logging. The tests validate the correctness of payment schedules and external event data regarding next payment amounts under various interest recalculation scenarios.

classes.name: LoanNextPaymentDueAmountIntegrationTest
classes.description: This test class contains multiple test cases to verify the calculation and external event recording of the next payment due amount in loan accounts under various interest recalculation scenarios.

methods.name: verifyAllLoanAccountTypedExternalEventHasNextPaymentDueAmount
methods.description: Checks all external events with the specific schema to ensure they have the correct nextPaymentDueDate and nextPaymentDueAmount.

methods.name: convertLoan
methods.description: Converts an ExternalEventResponse payload to a LoanAccountDataV1 object, provided the schema matches.

methods.name: verifyLoanEvent
methods.description: Executes a validation consumer on a converted LoanAccountDataV1 object extracted from an external event response.

methods.name: verifyNextPayment
methods.description: Validates that the loan account data's nextPaymentDueDate and nextPaymentAmount match the expected values.

methods.name: verifyNextPayment
methods.description: Validates the details of a loan response object for the next payment date and amount.
